text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the Wholesome Meat (Fees) Regulations, 2011 and shall commence on the same date as the Wholesome Meat Order, 2011. Fees.

heading.en: In exercise of the power conferred by section 38{2) of the Wholesome Meat

text.en:
The fees specified in the Schedule shall be payable in respect of the services or matters set out opposite thereto. SCHEDULE {regulation 2)

FEES FOR LICENCES AND PERMITS UNDER PART II OF ORDER Description of licence or permit Provision under which Fee payable licence or permit is issued Permit to export meat products Section 6 $3 per permit

FEES FOR LICENCES AND PERMIT UNDER PART III OF ORDER Description of licence or permit Provision under Fee payable which licence or permit is issued L Licence to operate a Section 11(1){a} $500 per annum slaughtering centre for poultry
Renewal of licence to Section 11(7)(c} $250 per annum operate a slaughtering centre for poultry
Renewal of licence to Section 11(7){c} $250 per annum operate a slaughtering centre for livestock
Permit to slaughter cattle, Section 11(1){b} $25 per permit plus buffaloes, horses and a fee of $10 per camels other than at animal slaughtered licensed slaughtering centre

Permit to slaughter goats, Section 11(1)/b} $15 per permit plus sheep and small ruminants fee of $5 per animal other than at licensed slaughtered slaughtering centre

FEES FOR EXPORT HEALTH CERTIFICATES Description of licence or permit Provision under which Fee payable licence or permit is issued Health certificate for export of Regulation 8 of the $10 per certificate meat product Wholesome Meat (Import, Export and Transhipment) Regulations, 2011

GENERAL Description of matter in respect of which fee is payable Fee payable For a certified true copy of any licence, permit, certificate $5.00 or other document issued by the Director under the Order or any of the regulations, or for the endorsement of certification by the Director of any document used in connection with the export of the meat products Made this 28th. day of Safar, 1432 Hijriah corresponding to the 2nd. day of February, 2011.

PERIN ORANG KAYA SERI UTAMA DATO SERI SETIA

A WANG HAJI YAHYA BIN BEGAWAN MUDIM

DATO PADUKA HAJI BAKAR Minister of Industry and Primary Resources, Brunei Darussalam.
